Spiel Der Maschinen

 
 
 

Spiel der Maschinen is an interactive sound sculpture. The system is controlled by a sequencer that we built in Max/MSP. Depending on the distance between the spectators and the installation, different midi commands are sent to the sequencer and Ableton live, controlling the Arduinos and manipulating the sound. Subsequently the vga input of the monitors is hacked and reacts on the sound.
This project was also presented on the Time Canvas festival at M HKA, sept 2011.
